reason: Replace an untextured, unidentified reproduction with an exact-object photogrammetric scan that preserves the photographed bronze surface.

previous.identity: Unidentified reproduction shown using the Musée Rodin monumental version as an approximate size reference
previous.surface: Untextured mesh using Atrium's synthetic bronze-patina profile

replacement.identity: Auguste Rodin, The Thinker, Copenhagen bronze M.IN 605, modeled 1880 and cast 1900–1901

review.views: Upright plus four cardinal yaws and six alternate axis orientations
review.geometry: Complete seated figure, rock seat and integral lower support. Eighty photogrammetry components remain aligned with the visible sculpture; no detached debris appears outside the object in reviewed views.
review.surface: Authored base-color, normal and metallic-roughness textures preserved. Synthetic patina fields removed; only the neutral default exposure is tuned.
review.scale: Full reviewed Y extent bound to the documented 73.3 cm height of M.IN 605.
review.controls: Exposure and Texture remain adjustable; no visitor-controlled light direction is restored.
